name: Dotharian
description: Dotharian was a planet located deep within Hutt Space. It was the home of the Mourner's Wail criminal syndicate, led by Lord Khamdek, who operated from a secure fortress. The former bounty hunter T'onga visited Dotharian to acquire information about the bounty hunter Nakano Lash from the Mourner's Wail, who Lash had betrayed years earlier.
